requirements.requirement: The system must execute an integration test that invokes the EvaluateCare facade and returns a provider evaluation response containing a composite score field.
The system must verify that the composite score in the API response matches the deterministic output of the scoring engine for identical input data.
The system must confirm that at least three provider quality measures are included in the scoring input during the integration test.
The system must validate that the API response includes both the composite score and individual component measures for a provider.
The system must confirm that the EvaluateCare facade calls the scoring engine exactly once per provider evaluation request.
The system must ensure that identical provider inputs across repeated integration test runs produce identical composite scores.
The system must validate that the tool_router integration path correctly serializes and returns the scoring output in the final API response payload.
The system must verify that the API response schema conforms to the updated FastAPI response model including scoring fields.
The system must simulate an integration scenario where fewer than three measures are provided and assert that the API returns a validation error response.
The system must simulate an integration scenario where the scoring engine raises an internal error and assert that the API returns a controlled error response without crashing.
The system must verify that provider evaluation responses without scoring (pre-integration baseline) differ from post-integration responses by the presence of the composite score field.
The system must validate that the composite score value falls within an expected normalized range (e.g., 0 to 1 or 0 to 100) as defined by the scoring schema.
